title: Utility Services Terms: Program Assignment, Package Opt-In and Account Activation
content:
# Program Assignment and Activation — Utility Services Program

**1. Program fixed by metering.** The program of a utility account is fixed by how the apartment home is metered (each program's metering), not chosen by the resident. The only choice is that a household in an apartment home with water, gas and electric submeters may opt into the All-Inclusive Utility Package, or opt back out to the Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan.

**2. Services billed.** The services an account bills are exactly those the program's coverage names — water and sewer, trash, pest control, stormwater, natural gas and electricity — and water and sewer are billed by the program's water and sewer billing method. A service not covered is contracted by the resident directly with the provider and never appears on the utility account.

**3. Program changes.** A program change takes effect on the first day of the next billing period and at most once in any 12 calendar months. A program change is accepted only on an active account; the account's status is read from the system record of that account before the change.

**4. Billed occupants and square footage.** The account's billed occupants are the lease's approved occupants count — every approved occupant on the lease — and its square footage is the rentable square feet of the apartment home.

**5. Activation and setup fee.** The account activates on the move-in or transfer move date and posts the program's one-time setup fee on that date, except that the fee is waived on the account opened for an in-community transfer when the program waives the setup fee on transfer.

**6. Account states.** An account opens as pending. It becomes active when billing responsibility starts on the move-in or transfer move date; it moves to final billing when billing responsibility ends on the move-out or transfer move date and the final bill is prepared; it is closed once the final bill has been issued and its balance settled or carried into the final account statement. A pending account is closed by the agent when the lease application is withdrawn before move-in, and it never bills.

## Program change requests

| Account status | Program change |
|---|---|
| active | may be accepted, subject to the rest of Clause 3 |
| pending, final billing or closed | not accepted |

*Example (hypothetical dates):* a household on the Submetered Water, Gas & Electric Plan with an active account opts into the All-Inclusive Utility Package during May. The change takes effect on June 1, the first day of the next billing period. If the household changed program on June 1 of one year, a further change may not take effect sooner than 12 calendar months later.
